selection_policy: The five documents with the most open-source annotations, yielding 30 original cases: 21 domain-relevant, 2 metrics-generated, and 7 novel-generated. Dev and test documents do not overlap.
notes: Questions, answers, justifications, and evidence are copied from the human-annotated open-source sample.
FinanceBench evidence_page_num is retained as zero-indexed page_index.
Consult the upstream repository for citation and usage information.
